text: What is the central idea of the poem 'The Lake Isle of Innisfree' by W.B. Yeats?
options: To escape the hustle and bustle of city life
To find peace and solitude in nature
To become a hermit and live a simple life
To explore the world and its wonders
correctAnswer: To escape the hustle and bustle of city life
explanation: The poem 'The Lake Isle of Innisfree' by W.B. Yeats is a reflection of the poet's desire to escape the chaos of city life and find peace and solitude in nature. The central idea of the poem is to escape the hustle and bustle of city life and live a simple life in harmony with nature.
